test_policy.notes: The 2024-25 catalog says UTRGV is test optional for the current catalog cycle; freshman applicants may submit SAT or ACT. International first-year applicants are admitted on academic records (foreign credential evaluation required) plus English proficiency.

requirements.notes: Apply through ApplyTexas ('own'); $50 non-refundable international fee paid through the UTRGV Marketplace. Applicants with foreign schooling need a credential evaluation (WES, FCSA, The Evaluation Company or IEE) sent directly to UTRGV. After admission: Certificate of Financial Responsibility, bank statement and passport for the I-20. TSI testing and meningitis vaccination are required for enrollment, not admission.

deadlines.label: Fall priority deadline (international undergraduate, fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: The page lists priority deadlines of April 1 (summer), May 1 (fall) and Nov. 1 (spring) with no year; treated as fall 2027. Applications completed after the priority date are still considered but processing may take longer.

english_policy.waiver_notes: No test needed for citizens of listed English-speaking countries (e.g. UK, Ireland, Canada except Quebec, Australia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Ghana, Jamaica and others on the UTRGV list). Exemptions after official transcripts: 30+ credit hours from an accredited U.S. university, two semesters of U.S. freshman English composition with a C or better, a U.S. bachelor's degree, three years of U.S. high school, or completing the Advanced level of UTRGV's English Language Programs intensive program.

english.notes: iBT, iBT Home and MyBest scores accepted; TOEFL ITP (institutional) not accepted. TOEFL Essentials minimum 6.5 is also accepted but has no separate field here.
The page lists 4 for tests taken on or after Jan. 21, 2026 without naming the 1-6 scale.

aid.notes: No automatic international merit scholarship amounts were found. International Student Services lists a $1,000 summer need-based grant for continuing students, the state-run Good Neighbor Scholarship (tuition exemption for students from Western Hemisphere countries other than Cuba and the U.S., selected by the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board), and 'I am a Buddy' awards of $500-$700 per semester for enrolled students. UTRGV's I-20 estimate for a full-time overseas undergraduate paying non-resident tuition is $41,668 living independently (2026-27 table).

sat.note: UTRGV's international admissions pages do not print an SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: No ACT code is printed on the pages read; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: UTRGV school code for TOEFL; scores must come directly from ETS.
